title: CloudEval-YAML: A Practical Benchmark for Cloud Configuration Generation

motivation: Cloud configuration generation is increasingly important for infrastructure automation, and standardized benchmarks enable fair comparison of generation systems and tools.
method: CloudEval-YAML provides a benchmark suite with test cases and evaluation metrics for cloud configuration generation systems. The framework likely includes reference configurations, correctness criteria, and baseline implementations to measure generation quality.
